states.description: Official notification or advance advertisement released by examination authority.
Online/offline application window is actively open for registration.
Application window has closed; awaiting exam scheduling.
Official exam dates or admit card release schedule officially announced.
Written/CBT examination completed; awaiting answer key or results.
Provisional/final OMR answer keys published; objection window open.
Written/preliminary results declared; merit list or cutoff released.
Interview, Document Verification (DV), or Physical Test (PET/PST) scheduled or ongoing.
Final select list published by authority.
Recruitment cycle fully concluded; all appointments processed.
Recruitment officially cancelled or withdrawn by commission/government.
Insufficient official evidence to determine exact lifecycle state.

rules: State MUST derive strictly from ordered official events.
Upload date alone is NOT lifecycle proof.
State transitions are monotonic based on official event timestamps.
